zh.watch.src.renounceOwnership: Ownable — renounceOwnership() 会把 owner 设为 0x0
zh.owner.what.closeMarket: 抽走整个市场头寸（全部 IMD + ETH），且 marketOpen 无法回到 true（L580 注释：Terminal）
zh.owner.what.withdrawFees: 提取全部累计 LP 费（token + ETH 两侧）
zh.owner.what.withdrawRetainedEth: 提取待部署到 backstop 的 retainedEth
zh.owner.what.dripperRescue: 扫走全部奖励缓冲（IMD）——即滞留待释放的 staking 奖励
zh.owner.what.simdRescue: 扫走任意 ERC20 余额——包括质押者的全部 IMD（totalAssets）
zh.owner.what.simdPause: 冻结全部存款、铸造、提款与赎回（renounce 被禁止在 paused 状态执行，L165-168）
zh.owner.what.distributorWithdraw: 抽走本合约全部 IMD 余额（含滞留的 heldBonding + heldNft）
zh.owner.what.burnExecutorRescue: 抽走待桥接到 Base 的 IMD（当前队列量见上面「第二道门」卡片）
zh.owner.what.imdSetPeer: 改跨链对端：可以把 Base 侧的接收合约改成任意地址，从而改变跨链销毁的落点
zh.owner.what.imdSetDelegate: 改 LayerZero 配置代理，可进一步修改跨链消息库与安全配置
zh.owner.note.simd.renounced: 已 renounce：owner = 0x0，rescueERC20 与 setPaused 均已失效。质押者的 IMD 不再可以被任何管理员单方面取走或冻结。
zh.owner.note.simd.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 质押资金可被提取，且可一键冻结全部存取。
zh.owner.note.hook.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 可随时抽走整个市场头寸（全部 IMD + ETH），且该操作不可逆。
zh.owner.note.dripper.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 可扫走全部奖励缓冲。
zh.owner.note.distributor.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 可抽走本合约全部 IMD 余额（含滞留的两个桶）。
zh.owner.note.burnExecutor.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 可抽走待桥接的 IMD，也可改跨链目标地址。
zh.owner.note.imd.live: owner 仍是 EOA —— 可改跨链对端配置，从而改变跨链落点。

en.watch.src.renounceOwnership: Ownable — renounceOwnership() sets the owner to 0x0
en.owner.what.closeMarket: Withdraws the entire market position (all IMD + ETH), and marketOpen can never return to true (the L580 comment reads: Terminal).
en.owner.what.withdrawFees: Withdraws all accumulated LP fees (both the token side and the ETH side).
en.owner.what.withdrawRetainedEth: Withdraws the retainedEth that was set aside for the backstop.
en.owner.what.dripperRescue: Sweeps the whole reward buffer (IMD) — the staking rewards that are sitting there waiting to be released.
en.owner.what.simdRescue: Sweeps any ERC20 balance — including every staker's IMD (totalAssets).
en.owner.what.simdPause: Freezes every deposit, mint, withdrawal and redemption (renouncing is blocked while paused, L165-168).
en.owner.what.distributorWithdraw: Withdraws this contract's entire IMD balance, including the heldBonding + heldNft buckets sitting idle here.
en.owner.what.burnExecutorRescue: Withdraws the IMD waiting to be bridged to Base (the current queue size is in the “second door” card above).
en.owner.what.imdSetPeer: Changes the bridge peer: the receiving contract on Base can be pointed at any address, which changes where bridged tokens end up.
en.owner.what.imdSetDelegate: Changes the LayerZero delegate, which can in turn alter the messaging library and the security configuration.
en.owner.note.simd.renounced: Ownership renounced: owner = 0x0, so rescueERC20 and setPaused no longer work. No admin can move or freeze stakers' IMD any more.
en.owner.note.simd.live: The owner is still an EOA — staked funds can be withdrawn, and every deposit and withdrawal can be frozen with one call.
en.owner.note.hook.live: The owner is still an EOA — the entire market position (all IMD + ETH) can be withdrawn at any moment, and that cannot be undone.
en.owner.note.dripper.live: The owner is still an EOA — the whole reward buffer can be swept.
en.owner.note.distributor.live: The owner is still an EOA — this contract's entire IMD balance can be withdrawn, idle buckets included.
en.owner.note.burnExecutor.live: The owner is still an EOA — the IMD waiting to be bridged can be withdrawn, and the bridge destination can be changed.
en.owner.note.imd.live: The owner is still an EOA — the bridge peer configuration can be changed, which moves where bridged tokens land.
